title: crepis sancta subsp. falconeri
intro: Crepis sancta subsp. falconeri, commonly known as Falconer's Hawksbeard, is a plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and digestive issues, due to its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Crepis sancta subsp. falconeri include its ability to stimulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial activities, making it a valuable natural remedy for various health ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
